title: 7.1 Multiply and Divide Rational Expressions
objectives: Determine the values for which a rational expression is undefined
headings: Determine the Values for Which a Rational Expression is Undefined

items.title: Be Prepared 7.1
items.prompt_text: Simplify: $\frac{90 y}{15 y^{2}} .$ If you missed this problem, review Example 5.13 .

items.title: Be Prepared 7.2
items.prompt_text: Multiply: $\frac{14}{15} \cdot \frac{6}{35} .$ If you missed this problem, review Example 1.25 .

items.title: Be Prepared 7.3
items.prompt_text: Divide: $\frac{12}{10} \div \frac{8}{25} .$ If you missed this problem, review Example 1.26 .

items.title: Example 7.1
items.nearest_heading: Determine the values for which a rational expression is undefined.
items.prompt_text: Determine the value for which each rational expression is undefined: ⓐ $\frac{8 a^{2} b}{3 c}$ ⓑ $\frac{4 b - 3}{2 b + 5}$ ⓒ $\frac{x + 4}{x^{2} + 5 x + 6} .$

items.title: Try It 7.1
items.prompt_text: Determine the value for which each rational expression is undefined. ⓐ $\frac{3 y^{2}}{8 x}$ ⓑ $\frac{8 n - 5}{3 n + 1}$ ⓒ $\frac{a + 10}{a^{2} + 4 a + 3}$

items.title: Try It 7.2
items.prompt_text: Determine the value for which each rational expression is undefined. ⓐ $\frac{4 p}{5 q}$ ⓑ $\frac{y - 1}{3 y + 2}$ ⓒ $\frac{m - 5}{m^{2} + m - 6}$

items.title: Example 7.2
items.prompt_text: How to Simplify a Rational Expression Simplify: $\frac{x^{2} + 5 x + 6}{x^{2} + 8 x + 12}$ .

items.title: Example 7.5
items.prompt_text: How to Multiply Rational Expressions Simplify: $\frac{2 x}{x^{2} - 7 x + 12} \cdot \frac{x^{2} - 9}{6 x^{2}} .$

items.title: Example 7.7
items.prompt_text: How to Divide Rational Expressions Divide: $\frac{p^{3} + q^{3}}{2 p^{2} + 2 p q + 2 q^{2}} \div \frac{p^{2} - q^{2}}{6} .$

items.title: Example 7.9
items.prompt_text: Perform the indicated operations: $\frac{3 x - 6}{4 x - 4} \cdot \frac{x^{2} + 2 x - 3}{x^{2} - 3 x - 10} \div \frac{2 x + 12}{8 x + 16} .$

items.title: Try It 7.17
items.prompt_text: Perform the indicated operations: $\frac{4 m + 4}{3 m - 15} \cdot \frac{m^{2} - 3 m - 10}{m^{2} - 4 m - 32} \div \frac{12 m - 36}{6 m - 48} .$

items.title: Try It 7.18
items.prompt_text: Perform the indicated operations: $\frac{2 n^{2} + 10 n}{n - 1} \div \frac{n^{2} + 10 n + 24}{n^{2} + 8 n - 9} \cdot \frac{n + 4}{8 n^{2} + 12 n} .$

items.title: Example 7.10
items.nearest_heading: Determine the domain of a rational function.
items.prompt_text: Find the domain of $R (x) = \frac{2 x^{2} - 14 x}{4 x^{2} - 16 x - 48} .$

items.title: Try It 7.19
items.prompt_text: Find the domain of $R (x) = \frac{2 x^{2} - 10 x}{4 x^{2} - 16 x - 20} .$

items.title: Try It 7.20
items.prompt_text: Find the domain of $R (x) = \frac{4 x^{2} - 16 x}{8 x^{2} - 16 x - 64} .$

items.title: Example 7.11
items.prompt_text: Find $R (x) = f (x) \cdot g (x)$ where $f (x) = \frac{2 x - 6}{x^{2} - 8 x + 15}$ and $g (x) = \frac{x^{2} - 25}{2 x + 10} .$

items.title: Try It 7.21
items.prompt_text: Find $R (x) = f (x) \cdot g (x)$ where $f (x) = \frac{3 x - 21}{x^{2} - 9 x + 14}$ and $g (x) = \frac{2 x^{2} - 8}{3 x + 6} .$

items.title: Try It 7.23
items.prompt_text: Find $R (x) = \frac{f (x)}{g (x)}$ where $f (x) = \frac{2 x^{2}}{x^{2} - 8 x}$ and $g (x) = \frac{8 x^{2} + 24 x}{x^{2} + x - 6} .$
